FIELD NOTES

Walk. Notice. Listen.

WASD or arrows move. E or Enter talks, examines, and advances a conversation. Use arrows and Enter to choose an answer, or click it.

L lights the lantern once Brin has lent it to you. Light can reveal a path the roots conceal.

Shift dashes after Tove teaches you the mossstep. Walk close to the gap on the bridge, face across it, hold a direction, and tap Shift. Deep water is still impassable.

I opens your satchel. Escape pauses. M toggles the original ambient score. Your story autosaves locally. There is no combat and no timer.

The optional archive ledger is held only in this tab and is never included in a story save. Download it before closing.
